subject: [PATCH 1/3] mm/page_alloc: drop unused gfp_mask from zone_watermark_fast()

reviews.author: SJ Park
reviews.summary: Identified the patch as clean and suitable for inclusion in the kernel.
reviews.raw_body:
On Fri, 13 Nov 2026 15:52:34 -0800 Joshua Hahn <joshua.hahnjy@gmail.com> wrote:

> zone_watermark_fast() has not used its gfp_mask argument since commit
> 2973d8229b78 ("mm: discard __GFP_ATOMIC") switched the watermark boost
> check from __GFP_ATOMIC to ALLOC_MIN_RESERVE.
> 
> Remove the argument, no functional changes intended.

Looks clean to me.

> 
> Signed-off-by: Joshua Hahn <joshua.hahnjy@gmail.com>

Reviewed-by: SJ Park <sj@kernel.org>


Thanks,
SJ

[...]

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Confirmed that the patch is suitable for inclusion in the kernel.

2026-11-13.patch_summary: This patch series aims to simplify the zone_watermark_fast() function by removing an unused 'gfp_mask' argument, which was made redundant by a previous commit. The change is purely cosmetic and does not affect functionality.
